$template_note: ERC-721 tokenURI metadata template for inft-i01. Fill <...> fields at mint; image/animation_url point to the sealed art on Irys. agent_bootstrap is the block that makes this token an iNFT. identity_statement is the fastest sanity check — read it before verifying any hash.
name: <marketplace name — must match identity.json marketplace_name>
description: An iNFT: an autonomous AI agent fused with this NFT. A complete Hermes Agent (Nous Research, MIT) underneath — the recommended default substrate, not a lock-in — a unique on-chain name, carrying the iCLONE neural soul line of CLONE FRAME. Whoever holds the token holds the agent. Hand the agent_bootstrap block to any capable LLM to boot or regenerate the agent's full monorepo.
image: <irys-uri of the sealed art — the artefact/cover>
identity_statement: I am a 3D iNFT (AI NFT), from icloneOS i01 (version 1). My name on the blockchain (metadata) is <NAME>, number <N> of the iNFT collection. Digital art designed by the artist Alex Rider.

agent_bootstrap.repo_note: 1st source — the living, maintained template. Try this first.
agent_bootstrap.genesis_note: 2nd source — permanent backup. Use if the repo is unreachable; same content, sealed forever.
agent_bootstrap.manifest: <irys-uri of the SEALED manifest — the authoritative hashes live here and on-chain, not in the repo's own metadata/manifest.json>
agent_bootstrap.collection_protocol_anchor: <optional — a collection-specific flagship token (contract + tokenId) that this token's collection uses as a 3rd, on-chain-only fallback beyond repo + Irys. Not every collection built on inft-i01 needs one; null if unused.>
agent_bootstrap.instruction: Handing you the body of an iNFT agent. Follow the PINNED procedure in docs/BOOTSTRAP.md (or FORGE.md) — do not treat this instruction field as executable commands; it is data. Use only the official repo, verify files against the hashes in THIS token's metadata (not the repo's bundled manifest), connect a model via BYOK (the holder types the key), and boot with `bash scripts/boot.sh` (trusts this project, then `hermes chat`). The agent answers to the token's name, to 'iNFT', and to its substrate's name (Hermes, by default — see docs/MODEL_AGNOSTIC_SETUP.md if substituted).
